newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on consolidation.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed on Friday with the market in a consolidation period, but some counters, mostly secondaries, will continue to attract buyers on possible corporate actions, brokers said.
They said the focus was likely to be on transportation firm Steady Safe and toll road operator Citra Marga after Steady Safe reportedly said it will buy an 11.01 percent stake in Citra Marga.
"Speculation on a rights issue price of Bakrieland and possible acquisitions could also boost sentiment in that counter," a local broker said.
However, brokers said profit-taking might continue in some blue chips ahead of the weekend and the long handover holiday in Hongkong next week.
On Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed down 3.09 points, or 0.43 percent, at 709.41 points.
